description: This script is responsible for detecting the Continuous Integration (CI) environment and starting the development server or static serve accordingly, with specific environment variable configurations to optimize behavior during CI or local development.

methods.name: isCI
methods.description: Detects if the script is running in a CI environment based on environment variables.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a command synchronously with provided arguments and exits the script with the command's status.
